explanation: Two vertically aligned elastic (e=1) bodies fall under gravity 20. Light lower body bounces off floor then collides with heavy falling upper body within the same step/substeps. Sequential impulse plus positional correction with full restitution amplifies the light-body velocity (40.2 speed at step 26) injecting ~46J in one step (225.3->271.6 vs E0 224), exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Making one collision inelastic removes the super-elastic amplification and the violation disappears.
